title: Image filtrations
statement:
Let $(A,F)$ be a filtered object [def-sp-filtration] and let $A\to B$ be a
morphism in the abelian category [def-sp-abelian] $\mathcal A$. The *image
filtration* on $B$ is the filtration

$$
 F^nB:=\operatorname{im}\bigl(F^nA\to B\bigr).
$$

Since $F^{n+1}A\subseteq F^nA$, one has $F^{n+1}B\subseteq F^nB$, so this is a
decreasing filtration on $B$ in the sense of [def-sp-filtration].

(*Stacks Project:* the analogous construction is the induced filtration on the
homology of a filtered differential object, Tag [012E](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/012E),
$F^pH(K,d)=\operatorname{im}(H(F^pK,d)\to H(K,d))$. That is not literally a case of the
definition above, since the objects $H(F^pK,d)$ need not be subobjects of one filtered
object; it follows the same recipe of taking images of a decreasing system of maps into $B$.)
